thread:
Anya Patel: FYI found a new downstream advisory for the NV driver that mentions a memory-corruption fix in 535.86.05. appears to affect driver-module IOCTL handling. filing a triage here.
Kevin Liu: linking CVE?
Anya Patel: https://nvidia.example.com/advisories/2026-xyz (internal mirror). CVE-2026-XXXX. patch landed upstream in 535.86.05 and backported to 525.124. needs signed RPMs for our Dedicated fleet. :eyes:
Samir Rao: impact matrix? which bundles (cuda/cuDNN/NCCL) are compat-break candidates?
Anya Patel: initial scan: CUDA 12.3 + cuDNN 9.1 + NCCL 2.16 okay on upstream 535.86.05, but on our older node images (kernel 5.15, driver 520.x) there are OOMs in long seq workloads. suspect driver api change around context eviction.
Maria Gonzales: priority for cloud vs on-prem? Dedicated customers need SLA; Private (VPC) may want opt-in.
Anya Patel: propose high-priority for Dedicated (auto-upgrade window) and opt-in for Private until we can sign backports. we need KMS signing plan for backported RPMs. @Kevin can infra help with signing flow?
Kevin Liu: yes. infra can produce signed artifacts if we have the canonical tarball + deterministic build instructions. question: do we require HSM (HSM is preferred) or a temporary software KMS for emergency builds?
Samir Rao: Security: HSM for prod signing. For emergency hotpatches use ephemeral KMS key with extra audit flags and retention. We must record all signed artifact IDs in audit logs. DevSec Bot: creating audit ticket #A-3321 now.
Anya Patel: steps: 1) create backport branch for 525 branch 2) apply nvfix patch (PR created) 3) CI build RPM + deterministic build manifest 4) request infra signing 5) run canary smoke matrix on canary pool 6) roll with staged policy.
Kevin Liu: for step 5, infra will run an automated compatibility matrix. need exact smoke tests. Samir can you draft?
Samir Rao: proposed smoke tests (short):
```
# smoke matrix commands
python -m tests.smoke --model "opt-6.7b" --seq 512 --iters 5 --mode greedy
python -m tests.smoke --model "mpt-7b" --seq 1024 --iters 3 --use-kv-cache
# NCCL ring sanity
./tests/nccl_ring_test --nodes 2 --gpus-per-node 4 --iters 20
```
Anya Patel: add cuDNN conv microbench and an end-to-end chat flow to validate attention state correctness. We saw subtle token dropping previously.
Maria Gonzales: rollout policy: canary 5% of Dedicated capacity (non-prod tagged), then 25%, 75%, 100% with 30m observation windows and automatic rollback on >0.5% error spike or latency degradation >20%. document in rollout playbook.
DevSec Bot: audit ticket updated: A-3321, attachments: triage notes, PR link, smoke matrix.
Kevin Liu: infra followups: 1) prep ephemeral KMS key for emergency builds, 2) add signing workflow to CI (jenkins->gpg->kms wrap), 3) schedule canary window tonight 00:30 UTC. I'll own.
Anya Patel: QA owners: @Maria please own smoke test pass/fail. @Samir please validate audit log hooks and ensure artifact IDs are emitted to SIEM.
Samir Rao: will instrument SIEM event: artifact.signed=true and include build.sha and kms.keyId.
Maria Gonzales: running initial smoke now on canary pool, posting logs in thread.
Anya Patel: thanks. after canary, if green we'll proceed with staged rollout and notify customers. otherwise hold and escalate to NV contact. :shipit:
